ACTUAL_DATA.shortDescription: The Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) is an active government scheme designed to provide financial assistance to micro-enterprises. It aims to support small businesses and promote self-employment by offering credit facilities. The scheme is currently active and serves as a key initiative for financial inclusion and enterprise development in India.

detailedDescription.introduction: The Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) is a significant government initiative aimed at providing financial support to micro-enterprises. As an active scheme, it plays a crucial role in promoting entrepreneurship and self-employment across India. This guide outlines the key aspects of the scheme, including its objectives and general framework.
